guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu rose from 0.29 to 7.69 (+2593%, z=+305) and its latency-90 rose +854% with socket count tripling, far larger than any other series; no other service shows a comparable shift. Caveats: the worst traces never pass through emailservice and the frontend errors are unexplained (logs contain only debug/info), so the link between the emailservice anomaly and the user-facing alert is not confirmed, but the CPU spike is the dominant and most specific signal.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice for a runaway process or CPU-heavy workload and raise its CPU limits or add replicas; if it is a stuck process, restart the affected pod after capturing a profile.
